name: hud_layout_node_apply_corner_text_quad
description: HudUiLayoutNode::ApplyCornerTextQuad reads a four-corner layout rectangle, applies an optional offset, writes four HudUiBar points, writes the adjusted output rectangle, and rejects non-array nodes.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; this helper is deferred to a coherent HUD layout/bar tier S pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x413b10 validates rejecting non-array nodes, reading left/top/right/bottom from payload[1..4], optionally adding offsetXY to all four bounds, writing points 0..3 through HudUiBar::SetPointXY as left/top, left/bottom, right/bottom, and right/top, and optionally writing the adjusted integer outRect before returning 1.
The native smoke verifies the accepted array path with offset, the resulting four bar points, adjusted outRect, draw vertex count, and the non-array early return preserving target and outRect state.
